UPDATE orchestrator_jobs
                    SET state = 'ready',
                        attempts = 0,
                        available_at = NOW(),
                        lease_owner = NULL,
                        lease_id = NULL,
                        lease_expires_at = NULL,
                        dependency_key = NULL,
                        last_error = NULL,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE id = $1
                      AND lease_id = $2::uuid
                      AND state = 'leased'
